# Per-track batch cleanup

Each batch item now owns a fresh DsreFileConverter. The service clears both its active-converter reference and the local track reference in a finally block. DsreFileConverter.decode retains explicit nullable references for the current resampler, DSP engine, and MediaCodec; its finally block resets the DSP, nulls DSP/resampler/codec references, stops and releases MediaCodec, and releases MediaExtractor. A decoder output-format replacement also resets and releases the previous per-track DSP/resampler state before replacement. Between tracks the coroutine yields, then uses a non-blocking 50 ms delay. After each fourth item, the service requests Runtime GC after references have been severed and uses a 150 ms non-blocking delay. No GC request or delay is added after the final item. The immutable 65,536-point FFT plan, Forward FFT sharing, channel worker pool, and two-stage cover finalization remain shared and unchanged.
